# Jeanette Wacher

Jeanette Wacher is a senior physician (overlæge) working in child and adolescent psychiatry within Psykiatrien Region Syddanmark (Psychiatry in the Region of Southern Denmark) [^src1]. She is named in the ADHD database documentation as the representative of the Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Selskab i Danmark (the Danish Society for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry) in the steering group's work [^src1].

The mention places her among the steering group members for the Danish ADHD database covering the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, a group drawn from all five Danish regions, relevant professional societies, patient organizations, and the Danish healthcare quality institute (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut). This steering group oversaw appendices documenting the number and demographic distribution of ADHD assessment and treatment pathways among children, adolescents, and adults, as well as regional variation in the use of the pathway marker for disproven suspicions of ADHD.

The available data contains only a single mention of Jeanette Wacher, listing her title and organizational affiliations without further biographical detail, claims, relationships, or timeline events. No further details are available.
